shortDescription: An 8-week General Gainz program that alternates between finding rep maxes and pushing them higher, biasing hypertrophy through lighter T1 work and higher volume.
descriptionHtml: An 8-week General Gainz program that alternates between finding rep maxes and pushing them higher, biasing hypertrophy through lighter T1 work and higher volume.
author: Cody Lefever
